total.description: The course total, kept apart from the items because its maximum counts only what has been graded so far — it is never the sum of the items above.

name.description: Empty for the course total, which Moodle sends with no name

kind.description: A consumer that treats every row as an activity will present the course total as one.

module.description: The activity type, such as assign

cmid.description: Course module id, for getting from a grade back to what was graded

grade.description: Null when the work has not been marked. Zero is a real mark and means something quite different.

display.description: Moodle's own rendering. For an item graded on a scale or in letters this is the only truthful answer; the raw number is a position in a list.

percentage.description: Null wherever a percentage would be meaningless, in particular for anything graded on a scale.

feedback.description: The marker's comment, in Moodle's own markup

feedback_format.description: Moodle's text format id for the feedback

hidden.description: The site is withholding this grade. Not the same as unmarked: reporting it as unmarked tells a student their marked work was never looked at.
